image_description: A close-up view of a vertical traffic light assembly mounted on a dark pole against a background of bare trees and a stone structure. The housing is yellow/gold metal with three circular signal sections. The top section displays a red standing figure, the middle shows an amber standing figure, and the bottom shows a green walking figure (pedestrian signal). To the left, a portion of another signal head is visible.
